info.title: Consume Data Subject Blocking or Deletion in Data Privacy Integration NextGen
info.description:
The APIs offered by Data Privacy Integration NextGen Retention Management (DPI NextGen RM) allow applications to initiate the blocking and deletion of data subjects. DPI NextGen RM will manage the process of blocking and/or deleting data based on the customer's defined residence and retention rules for a particular data subject role in the application. Once the residence period has elapsed, the applications should block the data subject's data.

The URL prefix for the following APIs is **/sap/cp/kernel/dpi/retention/v1**

region.description: BTP Region from where DPI NextGen is getting consumed from

tags.name: Data Subjects Blocking or Deletion
tags.description: The endpoint to manage the blocking or deletion of data subjects

put.summary: This endpoint allows for the synchronous blocking or deletion of a specific data subject in an application, based on their role
put.description: This endpoint allows the consuming business application to make a request to the DPI NextGen Retention Management for blocking or deleting a data subject associated with a specific role in an application. The process is synchronous, ensuring that the blocking or deletion occurs immediately, and the response containing the outcome of the blocking operation is returned.

requestBody.description: The request payload for blocking or deleting a data subject in an application

400.description:
Bad request - reason:
1. Invalid payload
2. Missing/Invalid Data Controller/Business Purpose/Retention Rule configuration
3. Erroneous response received from application's end
4. End of Residence/End of Business not reached for the data subject

401.description: Unauthorized - reason: invalid authentication token to access the API

500.description: Internal server error - reason: error with the application while processing the request

put.summary: This endpoint allows for the asynchronous initiation of blocking or deletion of a data subject in an application, based on their role as a particular data subject
put.description: This endpoint allows the consuming application to trigger the DPI NextGen Retention Management to block or delete a data subject associated with a specific role in an application. The endpoint operates asynchronously, and the status of the blocking or deletion process can be checked using the data subject blocking status endpoint.

requestBody.description: The request payload for blocking or deleting a data subject in an application

202.description: Data subject blocking request initiated successfully and the requestId is returned for tracking

400.description:
Bad request - reason:
1. Invalid payload
2. Missing/invalid data controller/ purpose/ rule configuration
3. Erroneous response received from application's end
4. End of residence/ end of business not reached for the data subject

401.description: Unauthorized - reason: invalid authentication token to access the API

403.description: Insufficient scope - reason: missing scope to access the API

500.description: Internal server error - reason: error with accepting the request

get.summary: This endpoint is used to get the progress of the asynchronous process for blocking or deleting the data subject's information
get.description: The consuming application can trigger this endpoint to check the status of a data subject blocking or deletion request in the DPI NextGen Retention Management. The identifier of the request, which was returned as part of the async request, should be provided as a path parameter.
